style: Motion-design showreel on a black stage. Precise technical UI against one organic moment (the portal). Heavy on camera and transition work: 3D swing-ins, a directional-blur whip pan, full-screen kinetic slams, a zoom-through push, a camera dive into the GATE node, flip-in cards, hash decode, slit match cut. Every motion lands on the music grid.
palette_notes: #d2a676 is used only for refusal. No purple, no neon; registry glitch ghosts recoloured from red/cyan to sand/silver.
font: Manrope (display, local woff2) + JetBrains Mono (system, local woff2)
asset_notes: No search: all material is first-party and already local. Portal footage (site hero video), bolt mark SVG geometry (frontend/components/layout/BrandMark.tsx), real policy-check verdict (causalmesh.yaml), real signed chain (data/raw/pilot_landing/..._C3__r0000/run.json), music bed + CC0 SFX from the brag skill library.
brief: Opens mid-action on the product's strongest real behaviour: a terminal swings in in 3D, the real policy check types, and REFUSE slams in on the first beat with a screen shake, a sand flash and an RGB tear, followed by a per-letter REFUSED wall. A directional-blur whip pan throws the frame into three full-screen kinetic slams on consecutive beats: GATED. SIGNED. RECORDED. (the site's own claim). A zoom-through push wipes in the architecture, which tilts up out of 3D while it draws, and a light pulse runs the route and detonates on GATE. The camera dives into the GATE node and surfaces in the signed chain, where four real events flip in as cards, their hashes decoding, and a signal runs the links to 'chain verified 4/4'. The cards collapse into a slit that opens into the portal's doorway, and the bolt mark assembles with a glow bloom and a specular sweep across the wordmark. One dominant motif: a single signal travelling through the system.

reuse.whip-pan-cut: ported mechanism: one strip carrying both scenes, one power3.inOut tween of one frame-width, SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 'X 0' capped at 16px peaking at mid-whip, hairline seam alive only during the whip
reuse.caption-kinetic-slam: ported entrance modes (top back.out, left expo, scale punch) for full-screen words, fitFontSize via canvas measure
reuse.zoom-through-transition: ported push: incoming clip-wipe from the right with x 60->0 and scale 1.04->1, outgoing drifts x -70, scale 0.96, blur 5px, 0.9s power3.inOut
reuse.rgb-glitch-text: ported tear: two ghost copies offset by custom props, steps(1) yoyo x5, recoloured sand/silver
reuse.text-shimmer: ported one-pass specular band via background-position sweep across glyphs
reuse.grain-overlay: ported fractal-noise texture; the infinite CSS keyframe loop replaced by per-frame deterministic offsets

hand_authored_gaps: architecture diagram (site geometry) with 3D tilt build and route pulse
camera dive into a diagram node
